relationships.subject: PKC/CaMKII/ERK/CREB signaling pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Relative to the DNP+BHF177 group, the BHF177+PMA, BHF177+CaCl2, and BHF177+EGF groups showed decreased PWT and PWL.

key_findings: The GABAB receptor PAM BHF177 raises PWT/PWL and dorsal horn GABAB receptor expression in STZ diabetic neuropathic pain rats, an effect reversed by the antagonist CGP46381, without changing blood glucose.
BHF177 represses NR2B, PKC, CaMKII, p-ERK1/2 and p-CREB; PKC, CaMKII or ERK activators abolish its analgesic effect, placing it upstream of the PKC/CaMKII/ERK/CREB pathway.
